provider.name: Paleobiology Database
provider.organization_type: global fossil-occurrence, collection, taxonomy, stratigraphy, geochronology, bibliography, paleogeography, analysis, API, download, and contributor-curation infrastructure
provider.description: The Paleobiology Database is a global community-curated resource for fossil occurrences, collections, taxa, references, stratigraphic units, geologic time intervals, paleoenvironments, lithology, paleogeographic reconstructions, abundance, preservation, and contributor provenance. It provides PBDB Navigator, a Classic interface, public data services, downloads, analytical workflows, and research and teaching resources.
institutional_context: Paleobiology Database contributor and governance community
Universities, museums, geological surveys, and research institutions
Paleontologists, stratigraphers, taxonomists, data managers, and software developers
External geological, bibliographic, taxonomic, and biodiversity infrastructures

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting PBDB documentation, organization, governance, Navigator, Classic, fossil occurrences, collections, taxonomy, stratigraphy, geologic time, paleogeography, environments, lithology, references, contributors, data entry, APIs, downloads, schemas, data quality, analytical methods, licenses, citations, software, standards, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: PBDB, its official documentation and releases, its governance and contributor records, source publications, official taxonomic and stratigraphic authorities, and cited external databases remain authoritative for identifiers, classifications, ages, references, versions, rights, and contact information.
